strings.malawiIntroTagline: From hazard signals to Red Cross action
strings.malawiIntroDescription: Malawi Risk Watch combines forecast models, confirmed event information, contextual risk layers, and operational reporting to support anticipatory action, response coordination, and learning across MRCS and IFRC workflows.
strings.malawiIntroMonitorDescription: Track forecasted and confirmed hazards from model outputs and partner sources. Forecasts support early readiness; confirmed events support response decisions.
strings.malawiIntroInterpretDescription: Overlay hazard signals with exposure, vulnerability, critical services and Red Cross presence to see where impacts may be highest.
strings.malawiIntroDecideDescription: Generate early warning and response reports that feed directly into Red Cross operations and partner coordination.
strings.malawiIntroLearnDescription: Link events, activations and reports over time to compare forecast with observed impacts and improve thresholds and models.
